# neuron v0.1.5 — a much faster lighting page

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). Installer and portable ZIP, with the app and CLI. Unsigned binaries; check `SHA256SUMS.txt`. `SOURCE.txt` records the build's source commit.

The lighting page got a much-needed overhaul. Scrolling the catalogue, dragging sliders and trying effects all feel so much better now. Changes also fade into each other on the keyboard, which is really pretty. This one was mostly about making lighting feel good to use.

![Lighting layers: an exploded engine render beside the actual spectrum editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/worflor/neuron/v0.1.5/artifacts/promo/release-v0.1.5/diagonal-screenshot-draft.png)

## Lighting

- **The page is much faster.** Rendering and saved-effect file work no longer block the UI, and offscreen catalogue previews sleep. Much less waiting around while you edit.
- **Changes fade into each other.** Switch effects or edit a look and the keyboard blends into the new scene. Change your mind halfway through and it continues from the picture you're seeing. Palette edits and layer reordering keep compatible effects running.
- **Layers have proper mixing now.** A scrollable stack with opacity, visibility, duplication and Normal, Screen, Add, Multiply and Cutout blending. If an opaque layer is hiding the one you're editing, there's a shortcut to it. Hover a catalogue effect to add it above or below your selection.
- **More colours to try.** Some effects now offer one-click suggested looks: opinionated colour and gradient pairings to start from. Pick one, use any other colour or gradient, or build your own spectrum. There are eight gradient presets, including Bubble's soap-film colours. Recognized palettes keep their names instead of turning into “custom”; palette and effect labels use the applied colours.
- **A tidier editor.** Smaller colour-mix and motion dropdowns, reverse buttons for colour motion and directional effects, and a more compact timeline. Effect controls line up properly too.

## Effects & fixes

- Comet light painting now fades over about 30 seconds instead of 2.6, giving you time to build up trails. Held keys no longer repeatedly restart bursts.
- Ripple keeps its waves during rapid typing instead of cutting an ordinary burst short.
- Smoother falling heads in Cascade and shaped Starlight twinkles. Typing Heat and Fire cool cleanly to black, and bright gradients still let heat read from dim to bright.
- Fixed unintended colour jumps at palette boundaries and after long uptime, and smoothed the breathing cycle's join.
- Fixed effect switches that could leave the previous effect running. Clearing the last layer turns the base scene black and saves that choice.

## Compatibility Lab

A new way to help add support for hardware I don't own. Collect HID interface and descriptor evidence, export a sanitized device-specific bundle, and use the included `neuron-compat` agent skill to prepare an issue. It can investigate non-Razer devices too; collecting evidence doesn't mean their controls are supported yet. Optional input trials ask for consent, and nothing is submitted automatically.

## Steam at 50 stars :P

If the repo hits 50 stars, I'll put Neuron on Steam for easier installs and automatic updates. Workshop sharing is something I want to build toward too. Might happen sooner, but let me beg for stars a little.

Neuron stays free. Any paid supporter option would just be a tip jar. GitHub releases stay too.

## Install

Use the installer, or unpack the portable ZIP into a writable folder and run `neuron-app.exe`. Existing lighting scenes keep full layer opacity by default.

Still the Windows beta. Linux has no release package; macOS has no backend. [Feature status and platform limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.5/docs/STATUS.md).

- `neuron-v0.1.5-windows-x86_64-setup.exe`
- `neuron-v0.1.5-windows-x86_64.zip`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
